notes.title: Kingdom of Cards 1.0 Update is Live!
notes.content: [p]Hello, Kingdom builders![/p][p] [/p][p]The exciting moment has finally arrived—Kingdom of Cards 1.0 is officially out now!🎉[/p][p]We want to thank all the players who supported us during Early Access. Your feedback has helped shape the game into what it is today.[/p][p] [/p][p]This 1.0 update brings the ultimate challenge, new ways to shape your kingdom, and a wealth of fresh content. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p][b]In-run Save System:[/b] Pause and resume your adventure anytime—no more worrying about losing progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Final Boss:[/b] Face the toughest, most epic showdown at the end of your journey.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Rush Mode:[/b] Unlocked after defeating the Final Boss, this new challenge will push your skills and strategy to the limit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked Kingdom Upgrade Flow:[/b] Early building choices are now more randomized, making your starting decisions even more impactful.[/p][/*][*][p][b]10 New Perks:[/b] Expand your tactical options and build unique playstyles.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Perk Slots Expanded:[/b] Equip up to 3 perks at once for deeper combinations.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Building:[/b] Recruitment Camp — Offer up to three loot cards to recruit a random unit. The higher their combined gold value, the better the unit you'll receive. Choose wisely, and may luck be on your side![/p][/*][*][p][b]Golden Packs:[/b] Buildings now have a chance to reward rare packs that contain more powerful cards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Cards & Combinations:[/b] Discover fresh synergies and strategies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Enemies:[/b] Take on tougher and more diverse opponents.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Achievements:[/b] Celebrate your milestones with new rewards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overall Improvements & Bug Fixes:[/b] A smoother and more polished gameplay experience.[/p][/*][/list][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]Whether you’re stepping into the kingdom for the first time or you’ve been with us since the Early Access days, this update offers brand-new strategic depth and exciting challenges for everyone.[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]And here’s a little teaser: on October 9, we’ll be launching a special bundle with Kingdom Rush 5. We hope you’ll enjoy this surprise collaboration![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277424/99a052e50fd83f2fd9b422bd83c3aefc1f036ef5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update Log V0.3 — The Kingdom Evolves
notes.content: [p][b]Kingdom of Cards [/b]Featured[b] [/b]at Latin American Games Showcase as part of Summer Game Fest with a New Trailer and Update Announcement!🎉🎉[/p][p][/p][p][b]What’s new in this update:[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Boss-Dependent Map Visuals[/h3][p]Each boss now leaves their mark on the kingdom — buildings will visually shift depending on who you’re facing, adding flavor and clarity to each run.[/p][p][/p][h3]Improved Combinations[/h3][p]The recipe system has been refined! You’ll now encounter fewer failed results when combining cards, making experimentation more rewarding.[/p][p][/p][h3]Custom Land Selection[/h3][p]You’re in control: pick which lands to include in your run instead of relying on random choices. Plan ahead and shape your strategy from the start.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Card Type: Loot[/h3][p]A new category for sellable treasures. Loot cards now stand apart from crafting materials.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Card Added to the Shop: Ezrick's Tavern[/h3][p]A new location card has appeared in the shop. Explore it to uncover a new kind of reward.[/p]

notes.title: Update Log V0.2.0 - Enchantments Awaits!
notes.content:
Hello Kingdom Builders,

In this update, we’re thrilled to introduce Enchanter’s Spires and a brand-new card type: Enchantments. Unleash your creativity by combining powerful ingredients and uncover hidden surprises. Alongside these major additions, we’ve enhanced the reward system, polished the UI, fine-tuned the game balance, and addressed several bugs to bring you an even smoother experience. Dive back in and see what enchantments await you!

[h3]- New Building: Enchanter’s Spires[/h3]
Channel enchantment cards and test your knowledge — combine the right ingredients to earn powerful rewards… or suffer the consequences.

[h3]- New Card Type: Enchantments[/h3]
Discover and experiment with mystical combinations to unlock new effects and surprises.

[h3]- Reward System Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Exploring now focuses on discovering new cards.
[*] Stealing offers valuable items for selling or rare special cards.
[/list]
[h3]- UI Improvements[/h3]
Visual upgrades across the interface for a smoother experience.

[h3]- Balance Updates[/h3]
Tweaks to pacing and mechanics for a better gameplay flow.

[h3]- Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Locked unit cards can no longer be removed from battle.
[*] Fixed an issue where shop units sometimes showed 0 attack.
[*] Other minor fixes and stability improvements.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Note V0.1.4
notes.content:
Hello Kingdom Builders,

Since launch, your incredible support and feedback have helped shape this card-built kingdom. Today’s update brings bug fixes, pacing improvements, and balance adjustments to enhance your experience. Check out the details below!

[b][Balance and Pacing Improvements][/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted invasions enemies and difficulty, especially in the first run.
[*] Updated conquer, exploration, and stealing rewards for various locations and invasions.
[*] Increased the number of location cards rewarded during runs.
[*] Lands no longer tap.
[/list]
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the issue where the blood moon never ends in certain situations.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented some achievements from being granted.
[*] Other minor fixes.
[/list]
[b]🎉 Thank You for Playing! 🎉[/b]

We’re just getting started—keep sharing your thoughts in the Steam Community Hub and on our [url=https://discord.gg/StXKG4xW]Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Demo is now updated with new features and contents!
notes.content:
Hello Kingdom Buildier,

The free demo of Kingdom of Cards has been updated and is now featured in the Steam February Next Fest! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367090

[b]Key updates include:[/b]
[list]
[*] Planning Menu——A new hub where you can check boss info, review your unlocked cards in the album, and buy new cards that may appear in future sessions.
[*] XP Shop——Use your XP to unlock new cards that might show up in your next run!
[*] More Cards & Combinations——New cards to combine them for unique results!
[*] Better Balance——Adjustments to make the game more fun and rewarding.
[*] Polish & Improvements——Various tweaks, fixes, and refinements to improve the overall experience.
[/list]

Meanwhile, we’re still polishing the game. And we’re almost ready to announce the release date—stay tuned!

notes.title: Kingdom of Cards Demo Now Available! 🃏✨
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The wait is over! We're thrilled to announce that [i]Kingdom of Cards[/i] Demo is officially live on Steam. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3367090/_/

[h3]What’s included in the demo: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Over 50 unique cards to discover
[*] 7 unlockable facilities to craft and enhance your deck
[*] 5+ areas to explore, conquer, or plunder
[*] 15+ enemy types to challenge your strategy
[*] A challenging boss fight that will test your skills
[/list]

[h3]Your Feedback Matters![/h3]

As this is a demo version, your thoughts and suggestions are invaluable to us. Join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/YRPBYRPwXa]Discord[/url] to share your feedback, report bugs, and discuss strategies with fellow players!

Thank you for your support, and let’s make this kingdom flourish together!
